sections.content: You know the *indefinido* and the *imperfecto* together from A2 Unit 22, *aunque* from A2 Unit 28, *por eso* from A2 Unit 5 and *sin embargo* from B1 Unit 1. Here you join them to tell how a habit changed: a reason, what happened and the result. Combine past narration, present habits and comparisons. Connectors such as *al principio*, *después*, *sin embargo*, *por eso* and *con el tiempo* help turn separate sentences into a connected account.

items.spanish: Al principio cocinaba muy poco, pero con el tiempo aprendí a preparar platos más equilibrados.
items.english: At first I cooked very little, but over time I learned to prepare more balanced dishes.

items.spanish: Decidí sustituir algunos productos preparados porque quería comer de forma más saludable.
items.english: I decided to replace some prepared products because I wanted to eat more healthily.

items.spanish: Al principio fue difícil mantener el cambio, aunque ahora forma parte de mi vida cotidiana.
items.english: At first it was difficult to maintain the change, although now it is part of my everyday life.

items.spanish: Como el cambio funcionó bien, decidí mantener algunas de aquellas nuevas costumbres.
items.english: As the change worked well, I decided to maintain some of those new habits.

sections.content: You know the *indefinido* from A2 Unit 11 and the *imperfecto* from A2 Unit 21. New here is *dejar de* + infinitive: it means to stop doing something you did regularly, such as a habit. *Dejé de fumar hace dos años* means "I stopped smoking two years ago". With *no*, *no dejar de* + infinitive means to keep on doing it: *No dejo de cocinar en casa* means "I keep cooking at home".

sections.title: Dejar de + infinitive (indefinido)
rows: él, ella, usted dejó de fumar
he, she stopped / you (formal) stopped smoking
ellos, ellas, ustedes dejaron de fumar

items.spanish: Dejé de fumar hace dos años.
items.english: I stopped smoking two years ago.

items.spanish: Mi madre dejó de comprar productos preparados.
items.english: My mother stopped buying prepared products.

items.spanish: Mi hermano dejó de beber refrescos y ahora bebe agua.
items.english: My brother stopped drinking soft drinks and now drinks water.

items.spanish: Aunque es difícil, no dejo de cocinar en casa.
items.english: Although it is difficult, I keep on cooking at home.

sections.content: Use connectors to show stages, causes and contrasts so that an account of changing habits becomes a connected narrative.
